title: 把生育目標放進計畫
checks: 只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致

textCues.text: 術後第 2 年半・跨科評估後暫停內分泌治療

prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. One continuous live-action cinematic shot. At the beginning, the short-haired woman at left finishes only the tiny last stroke of the existing signature, then lifts the pen; do not rewrite the signature or add text. Her husband watches quietly with his hands remaining clasped on the table. Next, she raises her gaze toward the bespectacled male doctor at center-right. His already open right hand makes one small settling gesture above the existing paper, then rests beside it. The female doctor at far right watches attentively, keeping her hands in their reference positions beside the tablet. Camera holds the reference four-person composition steadily throughout, with all four faces and the existing document visible. No lateral camera drift, zoom or reframing. The pen lift, changing gaze and small settling hand gesture provide the movement. Do not change medical graphics or produce readable text. Natural subtle acting, realistic anatomy and coherent physical motion. Preserve identities and all existing objects. No new text, logos or people. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 8.000 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Natural ambience matching the visible location: soft footsteps outdoors, gentle surf at the beach, or quiet room ventilation indoors. Physical sounds follow visible contacts.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
